appliedUpdates.description: Created .factory/library/benchmarking-results.md documenting final TQ benchmark results: TQ hybrid causes 5-11% synthetic throughput regression and 42-49% coding regression vs optimized baseline. Includes result file locations, TTFT anomaly note for capture_only, VRAM data, and when TQ could help.

Updated .factory/library/architecture.md 'Recommended production config' section: removed stale recommendation to use TQ hybrid, replaced with clear 'DO NOT use TQ in production' note with data reference and pointer to optimized baseline launch script.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add GPU recovery procedure: When GPU is in stuck state with stale VRAM allocation from zombie processes (symptoms: new server fails to start, VRAM reads >80% with no running processes), run: `pkill -9 -f 'vllm.entrypoints'; pkill -9 -f 'VLLM::'; sleep 10; rocm-smi --showmeminfo vram` and wait for VRAM to reclaim before retrying.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The production-recommendation-and-report worker (session 85f0ca05) could not run the VAL-CROSS-001 lifecycle test because GPU was stuck with 83% VRAM from zombie processes. The handoff explicitly recommends adding this to mission-worker-base. This pattern also appeared in a prior benchmark worker session.
